name: Akazukin
source:
A powerful girl who boldly traverses through the Jail. She likes that [url=/c57596]Jack[/url] has guts and enjoys having something to manipulate, in other words enjoy dragging him around.

She is said to be the first-discovered Chishiki Girl and though rough, acts as an older-sister type that watches over the girls. However, her hot-blooded instincts can sometimes cause a panic.
